newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish zloty edges up vs basket in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Polish zloty edges up vs basket in light trade.

text.p: The Polish zloty strengthened against the basket of currencies in light trade as the market's currency-selling sentiment did not fade despite large intraday gains by the U.S. dollar, dealers said.
They said the dollar's half pfennig rise in European trade pushed the mark down against the zloty, but reluctance to buy the U.S. currency kept the zloty flat against the dollar.
"The market's overall currency-selling sentiment remained intact despite large gains by the U.S. currency," said Marcin Trzykowski of Pekao SA.

The zloty closed at 2.19/2.14 percent from the trading band centre, up from 2.05/2.01 pct on Wednesday. It was at 2.8095/05 to the dollar, flat from 2.8093/13 and at 1.8335/50 per mark, up from yesterday's 1.8373/83.

Dealers were mixed on whether the zloty would continue to rise in the near-term, with some seeing strong resistance at 2.5 percent from parity and others expecting the zloty's bubble to burst sooner, and the currency to fall back to 1.8 percent.
Overnight rates fell to 18.7/18.95 percent from Wednseday's 18.90/19.15 and tomorrow/next to 18.80/19.05 from 18.85/19.25.
